references.text: In Isaiah 59:7, it speaks of evil and injustice arising from human actions, which corresponds with Mark 7:21 regarding evil deeds that spring from the heart.
Hebrews 3:12 warns against an evil, unbelieving heart, which can be seen in connection with Mark 7:21 about how evil thoughts come from the heart.
James 4:1-3 discusses desires and conflicts that arise from within, reflecting the theme of inner evil found in Mark 7:21.
